nodes.description: Owned.owner - privileged address controlling the factory and wrapper
Owned.nominatedOwner - pending owner for two-step ownership transfer
MixinResolver.resolver - AddressResolver used for contract lookups
Pausable.paused - global pause flag gating mint/burn
Pausable.lastPauseTime - timestamp when the contract was paused
Wrapper.token - underlying ERC20 wrapped by the wrapper
Wrapper.currencyKey - synth currency key minted/burned by the wrapper
Wrapper.synthContractName - resolver name of the synth contract
Wrapper.targetSynthIssued - accounting target of synths issued against reserves
WrapperFactory.CONTRACT_NAME constant used as FlexibleStorage namespace/key
Owned.acceptOwnership - completes ownership transfer for the nominated owner
Owned.nominateNewOwner - owner nominates a new owner (onlyOwner)
Owned._onlyOwner - access control check comparing msg.sender to owner
Pausable.setPaused - owner toggles the paused flag and records pause time
WrapperFactory.isWrapper - reads FlexibleStorage to check if an address is a registered wrapper
WrapperFactory.feesEscrowed - returns escrowed sUSD balance held by the factory
WrapperFactory.createWrapper - owner-only deployment and registration of a Wrapper
WrapperFactory.distributeFees - transfers escrowed sUSD to the fee pool
Wrapper.mint - transfers tokens in and issues synth, external calls before state write
Wrapper.burn - burns synth and transfers tokens out, external calls before state write
Wrapper._mint - issues synth to user, escrows fee, then updates targetSynthIssued
Wrapper._burn - burns synth from user, escrows fee, then updates targetSynthIssued
Wrapper._setTargetSynthIssued - reports debt delta to DebtCache and writes targetSynthIssued
Wrapper._safeTransferFrom - low-level call performing ERC20 transferFrom with assembly return checking
Wrapper.capacity - remaining mintable capacity based on reserves and max token amount
Wrapper.getReserves - token balance held by the wrapper
Wrapper.calculateMintFee - fixed point fee computation from mintFeeRate
Wrapper.calculateBurnFee - fixed point fee computation from burnFeeRate
